div.h2: An integration partner, not a connector plugin.

article.p: We build integrations that use Odoo's ORM, business logic, and access controls directly — not middleware that bypasses your ERP and creates a second source of truth.

article.h3: We've seen these failure modes before
article.p: Duplicate records, partial syncs, timezone mismatches, API rate limits — we've hit them all in production and designed our patterns around avoiding them.
Full source code, complete documentation, and a handoff designed so your own developers — or any competent Odoo partner — can maintain and extend the integration without coming back to us.

button.span: Can you integrate with a system that has no public API?

div.p: Sometimes. If the system has a database we can access, a file export, or a legacy EDI/FTP interface, we can build around it. We'll assess feasibility before scoping.

button.span: How do you handle API rate limits from third-party platforms?

div.p: We design integrations with rate limit awareness from the start — request queuing, exponential backoff, and batch calls where the API supports it. This is engineered in, not patched in later.

button.span: What happens if a sync fails midway?

div.p: Failed sync events are logged with context, queued for retry, and — for critical failures — trigger an alert. Partial writes are rolled back where possible so your data stays consistent.

button.span: Can the integration handle historical data migration as well as live sync?

div.p: Yes. We typically run a one-time historical migration first, then switch to live sync at cutover. The migration and sync logic often share the same transformation layer to keep the codebases consistent.

button.span: Will the integration survive an Odoo version upgrade?

div.p: We build integrations as standard Odoo modules following upgrade-conscious practices. When you upgrade Odoo, the integration module requires the same upgrade process as any other custom module — not a full rebuild.

button.span: How long does a typical integration project take?

div.p: A single focused integration (e.g. Shopify ↔ Odoo or a payment gateway) typically takes 3–6 weeks from requirements to production. Multi-system orchestration projects are scoped in phases.
